title: backlog.py check warns of an item whose goal adds a backlog.json setting or routes calls through another module without that file in its touches
goal: check warns, for an open item, when its goal names a new setting and its touches lack backlog.json, or names a module its calls go through (such as bl_forge) that its touches lack, or changes a _tools module whose kb/_self/map.csv docs (kb/_self/code.md) its touches lack; in SP-dqkf3i42 five of nine tasks had touches widened at dispatch and two workers stopped on a gate or a patch for a file outside them (TK-g4c5kxsc backlog.json, TK-uwu2lgvo bl_forge.py, ST-zmepvwav test_backlog_portable.py)
